title: kbingest map may run a repository rustc through .cargo/config.toml build.rustc
goal: Whether cargo metadata --no-deps invokes rustc (so a repository .cargo/config.toml build.rustc, build.rustc-wrapper or a [target] runner under the worktree would run) is settled from an official or CODE source recorded in the kb, and CargoMapper skips Cargo with a note when a repository cargo config names such a program, or the kb records why it cannot run; a test named kbingest_map_cargo_config_rustc proves the skip (sprint SP-xourq2gj review lead 4, unverified)
